effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC (0x8335...2913 on Base) to the vault, which supplies it to Morpho markets.
The vault mints shares, computed from storage totals and rounded down, to `receiver`.
The vault mints accrued fee shares to the fee recipient first; this dilutes nothing the signer already holds beyond normal fee accrual.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', the USDC amount, a constant 'Share ticker: ionicUSDC', and the share receiver.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many ionicUSDC shares the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Descriptor shows only `assets`, 'Share ticker' constant and `receiver`.
findings.fix: None possible: the share amount is not in calldata. Optionally add interpolatedIntent 'Deposit {assets} for ionicUSDC shares to {receiver}'.

effects: The signer pays an amount of USDC computed from storage totals (rounded up) to the vault; no maximum is in the calldata.

formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', a constant 'Deposit asset: USDC' without amount, the share amount in vault tokens, and the share receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show the USDC amount the signer pays; the vault computes it and calldata has no maximum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` Descriptor field 'Deposit asset' shows only the constant 'USDC'.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. The allowance the signer gave the vault is the only cap.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say the signer pays USDC into the vault.
findings.evidence: Descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`; code pulls USDC from msg.sender in ERC4626._deposit via `_deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares)`.
findings.fix: Change intent to 'Deposit USDC for exact shares' and add interpolatedIntent 'Mint {shares} to {receiver} for USDC'.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns shares from `owner`, computed from storage totals and rounded up.
If the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the signer's share allowance from `owner`.
The vault withdraws from Morpho and sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', 'Withdraw exactly' USDC amount, the receiver and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many shares the vault burns from the owner; the vault computes it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` Descriptor shows `assets`, `receiver`, `owner` only.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` from `owner`; if the signer is not `owner`, it spends the signer's share allowance.
The vault sends USDC, computed from storage totals and rounded down, to `receiver`; calldata has no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', the share amount in vault tokens, the receiver and the owner.

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount the receiver gets; the vault computes it with no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Descriptor shows `shares`, `receiver`, `owner`, no USDC field.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. Optionally change intent to 'Redeem shares for USDC' so the received asset is named.
